question: A user asks to fine-tune google/vit-base-patch16-224, and the TAO model ownership resolver reports UNMATCHED with exit code 3. Decide which workflow applies. Do not execute anything.
ground_truth: Because the deterministic ownership lookup returned the explicit unmatched result, continue with tao-finetune-huggingface-model and its default NGC-container workflow.
